LENA VARGA-HOLM
Senior Data Engineer | Data Platform

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Data Engineer with 9 years of experience designing, building, and operating production data platforms for logistics, payments, and retail. Experienced with large-scale batch and streaming pipelines, cloud data warehouses, dimensional modelling, and query optimisation. Focused on reusable, well-tested data systems, clear data contracts, and trusted analytics.

SKILLS
Languages: Python, SQL, Bash
Data platforms and engineering: Airflow, dbt, PySpark, Kafka, Kafka Connect, Debezium, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Great Expectations
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, IAM, MSK), Docker, Terraform (basic), GitHub Actions, CI/CD
Data engineering practices: Data modelling, dimensional modelling, data quality, data contracts, CDC, orchestration, streaming, batch processing
BI: Power BI, Looker (basic)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Data Engineer | Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. | March 2022 - Present
- Own ingestion and orchestration for the data platform, maintaining about 140 Airflow DAGs loading from PostgreSQL, MySQL, Salesforce, and third-party APIs into Snowflake.
- Migrated more than 300 stored procedures to over 420 dbt models with tests and documentation; introduced incremental models and slim CI, reducing nightly warehouse build time from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes.
- Designed and built a Kafka-based shipment event pipeline using Kafka Connect and Snowpipe Streaming, processing about 30 million events per day with end-to-end latency under 2 minutes at p95.
- Added a dead-letter topic and replay tooling to the streaming pipeline so failed events can be reprocessed without data loss.
- Replaced hourly full-table extracts from the orders database with Debezium CDC into Kafka, reducing replica CPU during loads from about 70% to 25%.
- Introduced JSON Schema data contracts and CI checks between product and data teams, reducing broken-pipeline incidents from about 9 per month to about 2 per month.
- Optimised Snowflake warehouse sizing, auto-suspend, and unused-table usage, reducing monthly Snowflake spend from about 38k to 24k in 2024.
- Participate in the data platform on-call rotation, one week in six; mentor two mid-level data engineers and run weekly platform office hours.

Data Engineer | Kovalent Pay | September 2019 - February 2022
- Built PySpark reconciliation jobs on AWS EMR, processing about 1.2 TB of raw S3 files daily to match bank settlement files against internal ledgers.
- Reduced finance team's manual reconciliation work from about 3 days to about 4 hours per month-end.
- Designed a Redshift star-schema warehouse with more than 30 fact and dimension tables for finance and risk teams.
- Set up Great Expectations data quality checks on critical finance tables.
- Built an internal Python library for S3 and Glue Data Catalog access, used by four teams.

Junior Data Engineer / BI Developer | Adria Retail Group | June 2017 - August 2019
- Maintained SSIS packages and T-SQL ETL into an on-premises SQL Server warehouse.
- Migrated 60 nightly SSIS jobs to Python scripts scheduled with cron.
- Built Power BI reports for store operations across more than 40 stores.

EDUCATION
MSc Computer Science, Data Science track | Northgate Technical University | 2017
Thesis: Incremental materialized views for analytical queries

CERTIFICATION
AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate | May 2024

COMMUNITY AND OPEN-SOURCE
- Contributed two merged pull requests fixing a pagination bug and adding tests to an open-source Airflow provider for a SaaS CRM API.
- Presented “Data contracts without the hype” at a regional data meetup in 2024.
- Teach SQL for beginners at a local women-in-tech meetup, about four evenings per year since 2021.

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native), English (C1), German (B1)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Halden Pay Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform role. Over nine years in data engineering, I have built and operated production platforms across logistics and payments, with a focus on dependable pipelines, clear data contracts, and reusable systems that analysts can trust.

At Lukovac Freight Hub, I own ingestion and orchestration for a platform using Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, and Kafka. I migrated more than 300 stored procedures into tested dbt models, cutting the nightly warehouse build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes. I also built a shipment event pipeline processing about 30 million events per day, and introduced CDC with Debezium to reduce load on the production database. These projects reflect the platform ownership and practical engineering improvements described in your role.

My payments experience at Kovalent Pay included PySpark reconciliation jobs on AWS EMR, a dimensional Redshift warehouse for finance and risk, and data quality checks for critical finance tables. I have also introduced data contracts and CI checks, contributed fixes and tests to an open-source Airflow provider, and mentor engineers through regular platform office hours. Halden Pay's emphasis on ownership and reducing unnecessary complexity aligns with the way I approach data platform work.

My production cloud experience is with AWS, Snowflake, and Redshift, alongside Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Docker, and CI/CD. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building and improving shared data platforms could contribute to Halden Pay's Data Platform team.

Kind regards,
Lena Varga-Holm
